findings.problem: regional is null, but in Switzerland people commonly say springen for running fast, which a German learner would read as to jump.
findings.fix: regional: { where: "Switzerland", text: "Swiss speakers commonly say springen for to run (in Germany springen only means to jump); rennen is understood." }

back.target: to run (fast), to race, to dash
back.example: I run to the bus every morning.

note: The hint "fast, dash" does point to rennen, but adding "not laufen" would rule out laufen more firmly, since laufen can also mean to run.
